tagline: Wi-Fi password exchange jo recording se crack nahi ho sakta.
description: WPA3-Personal WPA2 ke password step ko SAE se replace karta hai, jo elliptic curve par ek Dragonfly key exchange hai. Dono sides aise tareeke se sabit karte hain ki unhe password pata hai ki sunne wale ke paas guesses test karne ke liye kuch nahi bachta, isliye record kiya hua join offline crack nahi ho sakta. SAE ke baad, jaana-pehchana 4-way handshake keys install karta hai.

normal.name: WPA3 network join karna
normal.summary: SAE Commit aur Confirm password sabit karte hain, phir association aur 4-way handshake keys install karte hain.

steps.title: WPA3 beacon
steps.desc: RSN element kehta hai SAE, PMF required
steps.detail: Router ka beacon WPA2 jaisa dikhta hai, lekin uske RSN element mein AKM 2 (PSK) ki jagah AKM 8 (SAE) hota hai aur “management frame protection required” set hota hai. Jo laptop WPA3 support nahi karta woh join karne ki koshish bhi nahi karega.

quiz.q: WPA2 beacon ke mukable kaunsa field badla?
quiz.why: AKM (Authentication and Key Management) suite batata hai ki password kaise use hota hai: WPA2 PSK ke liye 2, SAE ke liye 8.

steps.title: SAE Commit
steps.desc: Dono sides ek scalar aur ek element bhejte hain
steps.detail: Authentication frames ab algorithm 3 (SAE) use karte hain. Har side password aur dono MAC addresses se curve par ek secret point (password element) banata hai, fresh random numbers chunta hai, aur ek scalar aur ek element bhejta hai. Dono commits hawa mein cross ho sakte hain: SAE “simultaneous” hai, koi side leader nahi hoti.

quiz.q: Kya Commit frame mein password se bani koi cheez hai jis par eavesdropper guesses test kar sake?
options: Nahi: element ek secret random number se masked hai jo device se kabhi bahar nahi jata
quiz.why: Element password point ko ek random secret ke saath mila deta hai. Us secret ke bina guess ko check nahi kiya ja sakta.

steps.title: SAE Confirm
steps.desc: Sabit karo ki tumhe wahi key mili
steps.detail: Dusri side ke commit aur apne secrets se har side wahi shared secret compute karti hai, aur usse PMK. Har side use sabit karne ke liye Confirm hash bhejti hai. Agar passwords alag hain to hashes match nahi karte aur join ruk jata hai. Har join naya PMK banata hai, isliye baad mein leak hua password purani recordings decrypt nahi kar sakta (forward secrecy).

quiz.q: Attacker ne poora exchange record kar liya. Woh offline kitne password guesses test kar sakta hai?
options: Ek bhi nahi: har guess ke liye router ke saath live exchange chahiye
quiz.why: Guess test karne ke liye ek side ki secret random values chahiye. Password try karne ka ek hi tareeka hai router ke saath SAE chalana, jo tumhe rate-limit kar sakta hai.

steps.title: Associate
steps.desc: SAE aur PMF ke saath join karne ko kaho
steps.detail: SAE ho jane ke baad laptop Association Request bhejta hai jiske RSN element mein wahi choice dohrai jati hai: AKM 8, CCMP, PMF required. Router accept karta hai aur Association ID 1 assign karta hai.

steps.title: 4-way handshake
steps.desc: Wahi chaar EAPOL messages, SAE PMK se keyed
steps.detail: 4-way handshake bilkul WPA2 ki tarah chalta hai, lekin uska PMK seedha password se nahi balki SAE se aaya hai. Isliye message 2 ki MIC password guess karne walon ke kisi kaam ki nahi. Key descriptor version 0 ka matlab hai SAE AKM algorithms chunta hai (MIC ke liye AES-CMAC).

steps.title: Encrypted data
steps.desc: Data ke liye CCMP, aur management frames bhi protected
steps.detail: Data frames WPA2 jaise hi dikhte hain: ek CCMP header, encrypted contents aur ek MIC. Fark yeh hai ki deauthentication aur dusre action frames bhi protected hain (PMF mandatory hai), isliye forged kick-offs ab kaam nahi karte.

outro.title: WPA3 ke saath joined
outro.text: SAE ne dono sides ko fresh elliptic-curve exchange se password sabit karne diya jise sunne wala guesses test karne ke liye use nahi kar sakta. Phir 4-way handshake ne SAE PMK se keys install ki, aur PMF management frames ko bhi protect karta hai.

downgrade.name: Transition-mode downgrade
downgrade.summary: Evil twin sirf WPA2 offer karta hai, is ummeed mein ki transition-mode laptop fallback karke crack hone layak handshake leak kar de.

steps.title: Transition mode
steps.desc: Asli router WPA2 aur WPA3 dono offer karta hai
steps.detail: Taaki purane phones bhi join kar saken, kai routers WPA3 “transition mode” chalate hain: ek SSID jo PSK (WPA2) aur SAE (WPA3) dono accept karta hai, PMF optional ke saath. Dono ke liye wahi password chalta hai.

steps.title: Evil twin aata hai
steps.desc: Wahi naam, sirf WPA2, zyada tez signal
steps.detail: Attacker wahi SSID aur BSSID wala fake access point start karta hai jo sirf WPA2-PSK offer karta hai. Paas hone se uska signal zyada strong hota hai. Jis laptop ne HomeNet ko “WPA2 ya WPA3” ke roop mein save kiya hai use kuch galat nahi lagta.

quiz.q: Sirf WPA2 offer karke attacker kya paane ki ummeed rakhta hai?
options: MIC ke saath WPA2 message 2, jo offline crack ho sakta hai
quiz.why: Attacker ko password nahi pata, isliye join message 3 par fail hoga. Lekin message 2 ki MIC offline guesses test karne ke liye kaafi hai.

steps.title: Laptop fallback karta hai
steps.detail: Laptop twin se WPA2 ke saath join karta hai. Twin apne ANonce ke saath message 1 bhejta hai; laptop SNonce aur asli password se bani MIC ke saath jawab deta hai. Twin valid message 3 nahi bhej sakta, isliye join fail ho jata hai, lekin ab uske paas offline guessing ke liye sab kuch hai.

steps.title: Defence: sirf WPA3
steps.detail: Agar router WPA3-only (SAE, PMF required) par set hai, to laptop ka saved profile HomeNet ke liye WPA2 kabhi accept nahi karta, isliye twin ka offer ignore hota hai. Transition mode ke naye routers, kisi device ke SAE se join karne ke baad message 3 ke andar Transition Disable flag bhi bhej sakte hain; laptop use yaad rakhta hai aur us network ke liye uske baad WPA2 mana kar deta hai.

quiz.q: WPA3-only profile ke saath laptop twin ke WPA2-only beacon ka kya karta hai?
options: Phir bhi WPA2 se join karta hai
Ise galat security type maanta hai aur asli router ke saath SAE use karta rehta hai
Check karne ke liye password bhejta hai
Saare Wi-Fi se disconnect ho jata hai
quiz.why: Profile sirf AKM 8 allow karta hai. Sirf AKM 2 offer karne wala network match nahi karta, isliye laptop kabhi WPA2 message 2 nahi bhejta.

outro.title: Downgrade block ho gaya
outro.text: WPA3 transition mode purane devices ke liye WPA2 ko zinda rakhta hai, aur evil twin ise crack hone layak handshake jama karne ke liye use kar sakta hai. PMF required ke saath WPA3-only chalana, ya Transition Disable ko maanna, darwaza band kar deta hai.
